verdict.rationale: Reducto documents a Zero Data Retention policy on Growth tier and above. API data auto-expires within 24 hours unless the user opts into retention with `persist_results: true` or runs jobs in Studio. Enterprise VPC deployment keeps all data and storage in the customer's own VPC. Together these are real, product-owned retention controls, but they are tier-gated and limited in scope. Missing for 10: an on-demand deletion API or endpoint, a configurable retention period beyond the fixed 24-hour expiry, retention controls on lower tiers, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: all data submitted via API is set to expire within 24 hours, except for Studio-run jobs and results saved with persist_results: true. This means that API-submitted data older than 24 hours is automatically deleted.
All data and storage reside in the customer’s VPC, while ephemeral processing is handled by Reducto’s dedicated GPU infrastructure.
